title: Warmly Wilted Italian Chinese Broccoli Calamarata
description: A comforting Italian dish featuring Chinese broccoli and vegan cheese, served with calamarata pasta, made in a kadhai vessel.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the calamarata pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
Heat the olive oil in a kadhai vessel over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped Chinese broccoli and cook for 3 minutes until wilted.
Add the lemon juice, nutritional yeast, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the cooked calamarata pasta to the kadhai vessel and toss to combine with the broccoli mixture.
Stir in the vegan mozzarella shreds until melted and well combined.
Serve the warmly wilted Italian Chinese broccoli calamarata hot, garnished with additional nutritional yeast if desired.
